snippet.title: Walled Haven - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Walled Haven An open world action-adventure set in the Walled City, a dystopian metropolis where Kung Fu decides all. Trapped in the Walled City, survival is never guaranteed. Explore its forgotten history, fight for your future, and rise above the chaos. Because here, Kung Fu decides who stands and who falls.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4188680/Walled_Haven/

Developer: Oni Craft 
X: https://x.com/OniCraft

#indiegame #kungfu #martialart #openworld
